prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- sign_in: 94.8%, median 3s / mean 567s

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Archetype Carousel: Redesign the story screen into a interactive carousel layout with animated archetype preview cards showcasing pet personalities before selecting a path. (why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a very long mean time of 514s, showing that undecided users stall on story selection.)
1: [adoption, layout] Checklist Layout for Custom Photo Upload: Switch the photo upload screen to a structured checklist layout with photo quality verification badges. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing incorrect visual results during adoption.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Screen Docking Sound Alert & Progress Timer: Add an active countdown timer and audio chime notification readiness setting on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step (home target) has an extreme mean duration of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off as users assume the app frozen.)
3: [finish, notification] Desktop Taskbar Notification Control Prompt: Add a tray notification tip component on the final screen explaining quick pet commands. (why: Multiple post-onboarding support issues stem from users losing track of their pet on the desktop screen.)

scores.note: Choose_path has decent conversion (86.1%); interactive carousel redesign requires full client release.
Adoption loses 29.3% of users and support emails explicitly report upload failures.
Extreme wait time (mean 2336s) causes 18.7% drop-off; audio and visual progress reduce perceived freezing.
Finish step drops 31.5% of users; post-onboarding support issues confirm confusion about pet tracking.
